common.tagline: Turn meetings into context you can use.

marketing.heroSubtitle: Loquia records, transcribes and structures your meetings so you can keep working in ChatGPT, Claude or any AI you prefer.
marketing.problemBody: Recordings pile up, notes go stale, and the context your team needs is trapped in hours of audio.
marketing.howStep3: Get a structured AI Pack, ready to export.
marketing.aiPackBody: Fourteen canonical sections — decisions, action items, risks and more — each backed by evidence from the transcript. Nothing invented.
marketing.presetsBody: AI Pack, Clean Transcript, Analysis, Writing, Full Fidelity or a custom mix — in Markdown, TXT or JSON.
marketing.portabilityBody: Your context isn't locked in. Copy to clipboard or download real files that any tool can read.
marketing.privacyBody: You control what is stored and for how long. Audio can be discarded after processing.
marketing.ctaTitle: Ready to give your AI real context?
marketing.ctaBody: Request access and we'll get you set up.
marketing.accessNote: Invite-only · Your data stays on your device by default.
marketing.rawSample: …so I think we should, like, go ahead with that, right? But Paul said maybe not by Friday, so…

access.requestSubtitle: Tell us a bit about you and your team.
access.name: Full name
access.useCase: What do you want to use Loquia for?
access.successBody: Thanks — we'll review your request and email you when it's approved.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Loquia
onboarding.step1Body: This is the language spoken in your meetings. You can change it per meeting later.
onboarding.step2Body: Record or upload a meeting and Loquia structures the conversation into an AI Pack.
onboarding.step3Body: The AI Pack is a good default — you can switch presets on every export.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.empty: No meetings yet. Record or upload one to get started.
meetings.deleteConfirm: Delete this meeting permanently? The recording, transcript and AI Pack will be removed. This cannot be undone.
